mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM queue q INNER JOIN appointment a ON a.id = q.appointment_id INNER JOIN source s ON s.id = a.source_id

SELECT q.id AS queue_id, a.id AS appointment_id, p.id AS patient_id, p.name AS patient_name, q.queue_no, s.visit_date, s.time_period, CONCAT(s.visit_date, ' ', s.time_period) AS appointment_time, q.sign_time AS sign_in_time, a.status, q.status AS queue_status, mr.id AS medical_record_id, mr.diagnosis, mr.treatment FROM queue q INNER JOIN appointment a ON a.id = q.appointment_id INNER JOIN source s ON s.id = a.source_id INNER JOIN patient p ON p.id = a.patient_id LEFT JOIN medical_record mr ON mr.appointment_id = a.id
ORDER BY q.sort_no ASC, q.sign_time ASC, q.id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
